spec_match.rationale: Covers the spec's full teardown fan-out: pending reader.read(), reader.closed, and a parallel clone().arrayBuffer(), plus the reason-can-be-any-value rule (plain string) and the specified no-argument AbortError default.

interactive.rationale: A radio group selects the reason kind and each run does a real fetch, real clone, real reader, and a real mid-stream abort; the matrix is filled from Promise.allSettled over the live surfaces.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises the edge matrix across surfaces and reason kinds; the page delivers exactly those three surfaces and three reason kinds.

edge_cases.rationale: This page is the edge-case concept: non-Error reasons, default reason, per-surface divergence, surfaces resolving before the abort (labelled inconclusive), route-unreachable, and — after Copilot review round 1 — a Response.body-not-a-stream capability gap are all handled distinctly.

references.rationale: Links the ChromeStatus entry, the Streams Standard, and MDN reader.closed.

conformance.rationale: The suite's body-stream-read-forwards-reason assertion pins the reader.read() surface this page observes; abort-accepts-reason pins the any-value rule the string mode uses.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via CDP: all three reason modes run; every surface honestly showed the substituted generic AbortError, the no-reason mode reported n/a-as-specified, and the verdict logic now tracks every surface so a fulfilled surface blocks the all-surface claims (Codex review round 1). Console/network clean.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts record mode and per-surface outcomes; inconclusive runs assert separately.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; kept/lost colors AA-adjusted and paired with text; fieldset/legend use the border tokens.

accessibility.rationale: The reason picker is a real fieldset/legend radio group with 44px touch rows; the matrix table has scoped headers and an aria-label; the log is a live status region.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP matrix: overflow 0 on both classes; long rejection strings wrap via overflow-wrap anywhere inside the table. Harness responsive-check confirms ok on both classes after the same-origin failure-scoping fix (Codex review round 1).

openQuestions.title: Confirm per-surface forwarding (including string identity) on Chrome 153+
openQuestions.detail: On Chrome 153+ all three surfaces should reject with the selected reason — including the plain string arriving as the string itself. Verify the all-forwarded summary branch and whether clone() body reads share the same reason value.

guidanceConsulted.query: async action button pending state error retry accessible status live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Grouped input + async run controls need real form semantics and status output.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: native radio fieldset for the reason kind, run button disabled in flight, allSettled so one surface's outcome can never mask another's.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: npx modern-web-guidance@latest search run 2026-08-09; no teardown-specific guide exists, general control/async guidance applied.

summary: Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CDP: DOMException, plain-string, and no-reason modes each ran; all surfaces showed the honest pre-153 substitution (or the specified default), console/network clean, both viewport classes inspected. Re-verified after the review-round guards: same clean behavior on this stream-capable engine.
